answer: The mould is split after the run, so clones cannot reissue the same sheet lot. I bond 31.6 POA at vat VT-12 for 46 min, beat 4.2 kg kozo for 28 min, and couch 16 sheets on a 38 cm willow mould. Drying ledge DL-8 holds a 9 mm jade caliper block. Checkers must read grammage 68-72 gsm and a 0.18-0.22 mm chain-line watermark unique to this mould. A second VT-12 claim, or watermark pitch within 0.03 mm of another lot, takes 58 percent and retires the mould. If the vat exceeds 29 C before couching, leftover bond freezes 15 hours; only a new vat and a freshly carved mould may restart.
